source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Planning a Small Digital Business under 9.4 as printed (PDF 133, printed 129).

blocks.text: Planning a small digital business involves organizing ideas into a clear and workable plan. Entrepreneurs first identify a product or service that meets customer needs. They then decide on the target audience, pricing, and method of delivery using digital platforms. A basic budget is prepared to manage costs and expected income. Proper planning helps ensure the business is practical, organized, and more likely to succeed in the digital market.
